def.zh-tw: 只由碳和氫兩種元素組成的化合物，也叫碳氫化合物，例如甲烷$\ce{CH4}$、乙烯$\ce{C2H4}$；國中學過的烷類都是烴。
def.en: A compound made of carbon and hydrogen only, such as methane $\ce{CH4}$ and ethylene $\ce{C2H4}$; the alkanes from junior high are all hydrocarbons.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下化學名詞：烴；碳氫化合物 hydrocarbon

def.zh-tw: 由許多小分子單元一個接一個連成的大分子，例如由葡萄糖連成的澱粉與纖維素、由胺基酸連成的蛋白質、由核苷酸連成的核酸，以及由乙烯連成的聚乙烯。
def.en: A large molecule built from many small units joined one after another, such as starch and cellulose (from glucose), proteins (from amino acids), nucleic acids (from nucleotides) and polyethylene (from ethylene).

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下化學名詞：聚合物 polymer

def.zh-tw: 由碳、氫、氧組成的一類生物分子，也叫碳水化合物，包括單醣（葡萄糖、果糖）、雙醣（蔗糖）和多醣（澱粉、纖維素）。
def.en: A class of biomolecules made of carbon, hydrogen and oxygen, including monosaccharides (glucose, fructose), disaccharides (sucrose) and polysaccharides (starch, cellulose).

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下化學名詞：醣；碳水化合物 carbohydrate

def.zh-tw: 由許多胺基酸連成的聚合物，含有碳、氫、氧、氮，許多還含有硫；相鄰的胺基酸之間脫去一分子水相連。
def.en: A polymer built from many amino acids, containing carbon, hydrogen, oxygen and nitrogen, and in many cases sulfur; neighbouring amino acids join with the loss of one molecule of water.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下化學名詞：蛋白質 protein

def.zh-tw: 組成蛋白質的單元，每個分子都有一個胺基$-\mathrm{NH_2}$和一個羧基$-\mathrm{COOH}$，所以一定含有氮，例如甘胺酸$\ce{C2H5NO2}$。
def.en: The unit proteins are built from; each molecule has one amino group $-\mathrm{NH_2}$ and one carboxyl group $-\mathrm{COOH}$, so it always contains nitrogen, for example glycine $\ce{C2H5NO2}$.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下化學名詞：胺基酸 amino acid

def.zh-tw: 攜帶遺傳訊息的聚合物，包括DNA和RNA，由核苷酸連成；每個核苷酸含有磷酸、一個五碳醣和一個含氮鹼基，所以核酸含有碳、氫、氧、氮、磷。
def.en: A polymer that carries genetic information, DNA or RNA, built from nucleotides; each nucleotide has a phosphate, a five-carbon sugar and a nitrogen-containing base, so nucleic acids contain carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen and phosphorus.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下化學名詞：核酸 nucleic acid

def.zh-tw: 分子一端親油、一端親水的物質，例如肥皂和合成清潔劑；去汙和降低水的表面張力都靠這種結構。
def.en: A substance whose molecules have one oil-loving end and one water-loving end, such as soaps and synthetic detergents; both their cleaning and their lowering of the surface tension of water come from this structure.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下化學名詞：界面活性劑 surfactant

def.zh-tw: 脂肪酸的鈉鹽，例如硬脂酸鈉$\ce{C17H35COONa}$，由油脂皂化製得；它的陰離子有親油的長碳氫鏈和親水的$-\mathrm{COO^-}$。
def.en: A sodium salt of a fatty acid, such as sodium stearate $\ce{C17H35COONa}$, made by saponifying a fat; its anion has an oil-loving long hydrocarbon chain and a water-loving $-\mathrm{COO^-}$ end.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下化學名詞：肥皂 soap

def.zh-tw: 本書指人工合成的清潔劑，例如烷基苯磺酸鈉，親水端是$-\mathrm{SO_3^-}$；它和鈣、鎂離子不容易形成沉澱，所以在硬水中仍能去汙。
def.en: In this course, a synthetic detergent such as sodium alkylbenzene sulfonate, whose water-loving end is $-\mathrm{SO_3^-}$; it does not easily form a precipitate with calcium or magnesium ions, so it still cleans in hard water.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下化學名詞：清潔劑 detergent

def.zh-tw: 油脂和氫氧化鈉等強鹼一起加熱，生成甘油和脂肪酸鈉（肥皂）的反應；1莫耳油脂需要3莫耳氫氧化鈉。
def.en: The reaction in which a fat is heated with a strong base such as sodium hydroxide to give glycerol and sodium salts of fatty acids (soap); 1 mol of fat needs 3 mol of sodium hydroxide.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下化學名詞：皂化[作用] saponification
